evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here
Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here);

If already graduated: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated);

notes: The tuition fee is in USD, as stated on the programme page ('7,000 USD/Year'), not in EUR or HUF. The application deadline '15th June' has no year, so it is recurring. Language tests TOEFL and IELTS are mentioned but no minimum scores are stated on the page.
